body:
So, I arrive a bit after the war, but I don't see the problem of having an icon instead of text.
Plus, we do it on the dashboard for our customers, most of them are regular profiles I guess ( not so dev in some cases ) and we still show them this icon.

I'm not strongly for having an icon instead of text, but since we do it on algolia.com, I don't see why it would be a problem on a community website.

![](https://puu.sh/wuE1O/3dff43ecd9.png)
